title: To Reason but Not to Stop: Understanding and Recovering Pruned Large Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight pruning can degrade the accuracy of large reasoning models (LRMs), yet it remains unclear whether it damages reasoning itself. We find that much of this degradation stems from a failure to stop rather than to reason. As sparsity increases, pruned LRMs increasingly fail to terminate within the token budget, often after the correct answer has appeared in their reasoning, instead falling into repetitive loops, even though they still recognize where the dense model would stop. We further find that the hidden-state difference between terminating and looping continuations is consistent across pruned checkpoints, suggesting a shared direction associated with committing to an answer. Building on this, we propose Termination-Guided Activation Steering (TGAS), a training-free method that adds this direction to the residual stream at inference time. translated_title: 能推理却不能停止：理解并恢复被剪枝的大型推理模型
translated_abstract: 权重剪枝会降低大型推理模型（LRMs）的准确性，但目前尚不清楚剪枝是否损害了推理能力本身。我们发现，这种性能下降很大程度上源于模型无法停止，而非无法推理。随着稀疏度的增加，被剪枝的LRM越来越难以在token预算内终止生成——这往往发生在正确答案已经出现在其推理过程之后——反而陷入重复循环，尽管它们仍然能够识别稠密模型会在何处停止。我们进一步发现，终止性延续与循环性延续之间的隐状态差异在不同剪枝检查点上保持一致，这表明存在一个与“确定最终答案”相关的共享方向。基于这一发现，我们提出了终止引导激活导向，这是一种免训练方法，在推理时将该方向添加到残差流中。在六个LRM、三种剪枝流程以及数学和代码基准测试上，TGAS显著提升了模型的终止能力。
tldr: 该研究揭示剪枝后大型推理模型的性能下降主要源于得到正确答案后无法停止生成而非推理能力受损，并提出免训练的终止引导激活导向方法（TGAS），利用与确定答案相关的隐状态共享方向在推理时引导模型及时终止，从而恢复剪枝模型的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that accuracy degradation in pruned large reasoning models stems mainly from failure to stop after reaching the correct answer rather than impaired reasoning, and proposes Termination-Guided Activation Steering (TGAS), a training-free method that adds the hidden-state direction associated with answer commitment to the residual stream to help pruned models terminate properly and recover their performance.
